lines.text: I lowkey want to stay home and nap.

data.define: Used to say something is true in a quiet, not obvious way.

example.text: I lowkey want to stay home and nap.

misuse.text: Don't say 'lowkey' about a huge, loud love.

publish.title: What does "lowkey" mean?
publish.value: Lowkey = Kind of, but quietly. Example: "I lowkey want to stay home and nap." (very casual English, US).
